questions.history: Compare two one-event streams: retry: 25 versus retry:25 followed by one trailing ASCII space. In each append a newline, data:foo, and a blank line.
questions.prediction: The SSE rule predicts 25 ms for the first and no retry value for the second, with identical foo payloads. The merged source instead appears to accept the trailing space as well.
questions.basis: The field parser drops one optional leading space. A trailing space remains part of the value and is outside the ASCII digits.
questions.refutation: A merged duration of 25 ms for the trailing-space event refutes standards compliance even if both payloads arrive.
